text:
Marta R.: Quick check-in: we need a single engineering checklist for the tracing + marketplace story. Who takes lead on the OTLP config and Datadog dashboard?
Ethan K.: I can own OTLP examples and a small collector config. Will draft today.
Sam (Datadog): Datadog will supply a starter dashboard JSON and a Prometheus-to-Datadog mapping note for our SI partners.
Lina (NVIDIA): We'll provide a short GPU telemetry addendum showing which metrics to surface (GPU mem, util, NVLink). Also a small perf note comparing A100 vs A10 for inference.
Priya (Kyndryl): Kyndryl will build the install/runbook and a validation checklist for enterprise customers. Need sample logs and a smoke-test script.
Marta R.: Action list (engineering): 1) otel-collector config + example pipeline 2) dd-dashboard JSON + PNG 3) perf blurb + CSV 4) SI runbook PDF. Legal/marketing: co-marketing terms + embargo window.
Ethan K.: Draft otel snippet (collector):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  logging:
  otlp/https:
    endpoint: https://ingest.redwood.ai:4318
    headers:
      x-api-key: REDACTED
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/https]
```
Sam (Datadog): Suggest exporting these metrics to Datadog with tags: org, cluster, model. Also recommend gauges: redwood.kv_cache.hits, redwood.kv_cache.misses, redwood.tokens.generated.
Lina (NVIDIA): We'll validate tagging and add a note: "enable nv_gpu.* counters for kernel-level visibility". Sending perf CSV by EOD.
Priya (Kyndryl): For the runbook we need an automated smoke test. Proposal: curl to /health, a small inference request, and verify tracing spans appear in Datadog with model tag. I'll sketch the script.
Marta R.: Marketing: propose 2-week window: partner-only preview -> SI enablement -> coordinated marketplace tile updates -> public blog. Press embargo of 72h.
Sam (Datadog): Datadog legal requests 4 business days for co-branded assets signoff. We should factor that in.
Ethan K.: Technical note: runtime needs to emit span attributes: model.name, model.version, batch.size. Will open a PR to add these attributes to spans.
Lina (NVIDIA): Also add a span attribute gpu.count so SIs can correlate performance.
Priya (Kyndryl): We'll include those attributes in our validation checklist. Also want a sample customer scenario for the marketplace listing (ML infra + compliance).
Marta R.: Can someone nominate a customer quote? Sam?
Sam (Datadog): I have one customer who might be open to a short line. I'll ping them.
press-bot: Note: Partner announcement meeting scheduled for 2025-10-20 15:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).
Ethan K.: I'll post the collector config PR and attach a minimal dashboard JSON mock by tomorrow.
Marta R.: Great. Owners: Ethan=OTEL/config & PR, Sam=DD dashboard + legal coord, Lina=perf assets, Priya=SI runbook, Marta=marketing cadence + press. Update the shared checklist doc by Friday COB. :rocket:
